title: Race Condition Prevention — TypeScript & Python
title_es: Prevención de race conditions — TypeScript y Python
description: Runnable implementations of the six async race-condition patterns: AbortController cancellation, serialized promise queue, latest-only request IDs, Mutex, compare-and-swap and an asyncio.Lock transfer example.
description_es: Implementaciones ejecutables de los seis patrones contra race conditions async: cancelación con AbortController, cola de promises serializada, request IDs solo-última, Mutex, compare-and-swap y un ejemplo de transferencias con asyncio.Lock.
